shots.visual: A man in a scholar robe is kneeling on the floor, tears in his eyes, looking up with desperation.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，二爺三爺之仇不報了嗎？

shots.visual: A man in royal armor stands with his back turned, hands clasped behind him, staring at a strategic map.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 哭，能哭死東吳那幫鼠輩嗎？

shots.visual: The man in armor turns around slowly, his eyes cold and sharp like a predator.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 報仇，要先奪下這天下！

shots.visual: The scholar looks shocked, his eyes widening as if seeing a complete stranger.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，您竟變得如此冷靜……

shots.visual: The man in armor walks to the table and slams a heavy jade seal onto the map.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳朕旨意，即刻聯吳抗魏！

shots.visual: The scholar's hand trembles as he reaches for the map, his face filled with confusion.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 聯吳？三軍將士定會譁變！

shots.visual: The man in armor narrows his eyes, a flicker of killing intent passing through them.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 誰敢譁變，朕就送他去見雲長。

shots.visual: The scholar stands up slowly, adjusting his fan, his expression turning solemn.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 亮，斗膽請問主公下一步。

shots.visual: The man in armor points to the northern border on the map, his finger pressing hard.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕老兒，正等著火燒連營呢。

shots.visual: The man in armor stands on a hill overlooking the vast army, the setting sun turning his cape blood-red.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 他想漁翁得利，朕偏不讓他如願。

shots.visual: The scholar is staring at the map, his eyes reflecting intense mental calculation.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公所料，竟與天機不謀而合。

shots.visual: The man in armor gives a faint, mysterious smile, looking toward the horizon.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 天機？朕這條命就是天機。

shots.visual: A man with a purple beard and green eyes stands on a ship deck, laughing with arrogance.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備那大耳賊，此刻必死無疑！

shots.visual: A beautiful woman in red armor clutches her sword, her face pale and worried.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 兄長，難道真的不顧聯姻之情？

shots.visual: The man with the purple beard turns to her, his expression cold and ruthless.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 成大事者，何惜區區一個劉備！

shots.visual: Back in the tent, the man in armor suddenly hears a commotion outside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 急報！北邊有重大軍情！

shots.visual: A soldier rushes in and collapses on his knees before the two men.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 主公！魏軍動了！

shots.visual: The man in armor doesn't flinch, his eyes remaining fixed on the map.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 說，曹丕派了多少人？

shots.visual: The scholar's face pales as he listens to the soldier's trembling voice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魏軍五十萬，已渡過大河！

shots.visual: A man in dark imperial robes sits on a throne, a cruel sneer on his face.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 劉備，這一次朕要你死無全屍！

shots.visual: The man in armor looks directly into the camera, his eyes filled with a terrifying resolve.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 五十萬？剛好給朕祭旗！
